0022600002.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Philadelphia 76ers visit the New York Knicks. The 76ers will be without Ariel Hukporti (ruptured Achilles), Dean Wade (ankle sprain), Dominick Barlow (back) and Tacko Fall (hip). The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the 76ers lost 0-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, most recently a 144-114 loss in Philadelphia on May 10.
